name: fairshop-carrier-adjustments
description: Checks carrier adjustments (UPS, FedEx, USPS) against the weights and dimensions you entered on the label: adjustments your own data disproves, with a dispute-by date, adjustments that are right because your product data is wrong (and the SKUs that keep causing them), address corrections, and adjustments past their window. Drafts the dispute; never files it or pays.
